app.import_a_question_bank_to_create_you: Import a question bank to create your first deck.
app.you_can_generate_the_bank_with_any_a: You can generate the bank with any assistant, then bring it here.
app.json_csv_and_tsv_no_ai_account_neede: JSON, CSV and TSV · No AI account needed
app.good_learning_starts_with_good_quest: Good learning starts with good questions. Keep yours accurate.
app.mastery_needs_repeated_active_recall: Mastery needs repeated active recall. A lucky guess doesn’t count.
app.recognition_and_self_assessment_are_: Recognition and self-assessment are recorded separately.
app.no_missed_questions_yet_start_a_sess: No missed questions yet. Start a session to discover what needs practice.
app.your_quizzes_and_progress_stay_in_th: Your quizzes and progress stay in this browser or app. No account or server is needed.
app.your_server_stores_shared_questions_: Your server stores shared questions and progress; downloaded mode keeps a copy on this device.
app.a_new_web_app_is_downloaded_save_rel: A new web app is downloaded. Save & reload preserves your current answer draft and pending progress.
app.your_app_keeps_working_while_an_upda: Your app keeps working while an update downloads. It never reloads an active study session automatically.
app.windows_android_installations_bundle: Windows/Android installations bundle their own interface. Download a newer installer to update it; your workspace stays separate from application files.
app.saved_on_this_device_use_the_sun_moo: Saved on this device. Use the sun/moon button in the header to switch instantly.
app.use_read_aloud_on_a_question_or_reve: Use Read aloud on a question or revealed answer. Recall uses locally installed speech voices when your browser provides them; it never reads an answer before it is revealed.
app.for_dictation_focus_the_answer_field: Dictate answer writes into the answer box and keeps listening through pauses until you stop or submit. Voice options selects the spoken language and whether the browser’s speech service is allowed. Keyboard/OS dictation remains available.
app.import_a_recall_json_or_ordinary_que: Import a .recall.json or ordinary question-bank JSON file. Study, edit and organize without a server. Export a quiz for your friend, or include progress to move your own learning to another device.
app.your_browser_and_phone_keep_separate: Your browser and phone keep separate copies. Clearing app/site data removes local quizzes and progress, so keep exported backup files.
app.download_the_full_quiz_and_study_wit: Download the full quiz and study without contacting the server for each answer. Progress saves here immediately, then syncs when you finish, leave, or refresh. New questions arrive only when you refresh.
app.downloaded_quizzes_are_up_to_date: Downloaded quizzes are up to date.
app.private_recovery_export_prepared_it_: Private recovery export prepared. It includes pending answers; keep it safe and use the recovery CLI to replay it.
app.if_the_server_stays_unavailable_expo: If the server stays unavailable, export pending evidence before clearing storage or changing devices. This private recovery file includes typed answers. It is separate from a quiz-sharing file; export does not clear the outbox.
app.phone_and_computer_keep_their_own_do: Phone and computer keep their own downloads. Refresh either device to pick up progress from the other. Clearing browser storage removes unsynced local attempts.
app.device_only_storage_is_independent_o: Device-only storage is independent of any server workspace. To use a shared server, open its HTTPS address in your browser, or select it in the Android connection screen.
app.you_can_also_use_an_independent_devi: You can also use an independent device-only workspace. Your existing server downloads and pending progress are kept separately.
app.use_any_assistant_to_prepare_a_struc: Use any assistant to prepare a structured bank, then import it here or through the CLI. Recall has no AI integration or subscription.
app.three_consecutive_successes_includin: Three consecutive successes, including at least two written or self-rated recalls, establish initial mastery. Questions return for later review. Mistakes reset the streak; editing the material resets the affected objective.
app.free_form_answers_use_a_model_answer: Free-form answers use a model answer and your honest self-assessment. Structured answers use explicit accepted answers, never a fuzzy guess.
app.take_your_time_trust_what_you_know: Take your time. Trust what you know.
app.assisted_practice_this_answer_does_n: Assisted practice. This answer does not increase unaided recall or unlock prerequisites.
app.assisted_practice_try_it_without_a_h: Assisted practice — try it without a hint next time to build mastery.
app.start_by_recognising_the_answer_you_: Start by recognising the answer. You’ll recall it without options next.
app.now_recall_it_without_the_choices_tw: Now recall it without the choices. Two successful recalls build mastery.
app.choose_one_answer_it_submits_immedia: Choose one answer — it submits immediately.
app.choose_one_answer_then_check_it: Choose one answer, then check it.
app.choose_the_matching_answer_for_each_: Choose the matching answer for each item.
app.recall_it_in_your_own_words: Recall it in your own words…
app.you_ll_compare_with_a_model_answer_a: You’ll compare with a model answer and assess your recall.
app.for_multi_part_rules_separate_each_p: For multi-part rules, separate each part with a semicolon. Accepted wording is checked explicitly.
app.compare_your_answer_with_the_model: Compare your answer with the model
app.click_an_answer_or_press_1_to_submit: Click an answer or press 1–{{max}} to submit{{value}}
app.enter_to_check_shift_enter_for_a_new: Enter to check · Shift + Enter for a new line
app.saved_on_this_device_syncs_when_you_: Saved on this device. Syncs when you finish or leave.
app.your_progress_saves_after_every_answ: Your progress saves after every answer.
app.this_clears_this_deck_s_mastery_answ: This clears this deck’s mastery, answer counters and review dates, ends its saved sessions, and discards its pending answers. Questions and prerequisite links stay in your library. New learning begins with multiple choice.
app.this_affects_only_this_device_s_pers: This affects only this device’s personal workspace.
app.this_resets_the_shared_deck_across_c: This resets the shared deck across connected devices. Other devices must reload it; their older pending answers will no longer count.
app.download_a_progress_backup_first_if_: Download a progress backup first if you may want to restore your learning later. Progress files can be restored in a device-only workspace.
app.discard_answers_from_before_the_rese: Discard answers from before the reset?
app.reset_decks_reloaded_other_pending_a: Reset decks reloaded. Other pending answers were kept.
app.the_server_has_a_newer_learning_rese: The server has a newer learning reset. These older pending answers cannot count toward that new run.
app.export_a_private_evidence_backup_if_: Export a private evidence backup if you want to keep them, then discard only the outdated answers and download those decks again. Pending answers for other decks stay on this device.
results.every_attempt_makes_the_next_rec: Every attempt makes the next recall a little easier.
results.unanswered_questions_unanswered_: unanswered questions · Unanswered items are excluded from accuracy.
results.answers_used_hints_assisted_answ: answers used hints. Assisted answers are excluded from unaided mastery.
results.includes_repeated_attempts_durin: Includes repeated attempts during Learn and Cram.
controls.single_choice_uses_answer_butto: Single choice uses answer buttons. Multiple-answer questions use checkboxes and a Check button so you can finish choosing.
controls.number_keys_choose_answers_ente: Number keys choose answers. Enter checks typed or multiple-answer responses; Shift+Enter adds a line. Tab, Escape and modifier shortcuts remain available.
flag.this_question_will_be_skipped_in_ev: This question will be skipped in every study mode until you remove its flag. Its existing progress is kept.
flag.what_is_unclear_incorrect_or_worth_: What is unclear, incorrect, or worth rewriting?
flag.review_the_affected_questions_below: Review the affected questions below. Hover over a prompt or expand it to see its answer.
flag.keep_them_locked_on_this_prerequisi: Keep them locked on this prerequisite
flag.recommended_while_an_incorrect_foun: Recommended while an incorrect foundation needs fixing.
flag.follow_ups_can_appear_when_their_ot: Follow-ups can appear when their other prerequisites are met. Downstream questions still require their own foundations. This does not mark the flagged question mastered.
flag.the_flag_and_note_travel_with_quest: The flag and note travel with question-bank exports, so you or an assistant can review them later.
editor.changing_the_question_or_answer_r: Changing the question or answer resets this objective’s progress and excludes old attempts from scores.
editor.fix_the_json_before_switching_to_: Fix the JSON before switching to the form.
editor.learn_these_first_every_selected_: Learn these first. Every selected question must be mastered before this one unlocks. Topics are just groups.
editor.selected_empty_selection_means_av: selected · Empty selection means available immediately.

editor.a_cue_or_a_starting_point_without: A cue or a starting point, without giving away the answer
editor.shown_only_when_requested_during_: Shown only when requested during open recall. Hint-assisted answers do not build unaided mastery. Leave blank for no hint.
editor.accepted_written_answers_one_per_: Accepted written answers · one per line
editor.required_parts_one_per_line_alias: Required parts · one per line, aliases separated by |
editor.edit_scenario_variants_matching_p: Edit scenario variants, matching pairs and rubrics in “All formats”.

share.use_this_to_move_your_own_progress: Use this to move your own progress between devices. The recipient can choose whether to restore it.
share.questions_only_your_friend_starts_: Questions only: your friend starts with their own progress. No server addresses, credentials or learning history are included.
import.use_the_cli_for_csv_or_tsv_import: Use the CLI for CSV or TSV imports. This dialog accepts JSON.
import.choose_a_file_smaller_than_5_mb: Choose a file smaller than 5 MB.
import.import_a_shared_recall_json_file_: Import a shared .recall.json file or a plain JSON bank. Matching IDs update existing questions. Preview changes before applying them.
import.restore_progress_from_this_file_r: Restore progress from this file (replace progress for matching questions)
import.this_file_includes_progress_use_a: This file includes progress. Use a device-only workspace to restore it; server imports use questions only.
import.matching_progress_from_this_file_: ; matching progress from this file will then be restored
import.your_existing_progress_is_kept_fo: . Your existing progress is kept for unchanged questions.
import.replace_this_deck_archive_questio: Replace this deck: archive questions absent from the file

updates.could_not_check_for_an_app_updat: Could not check for an app update. Your current app and learning data are kept.
study.editedAttempt: This question has been edited. Its previous attempt is excluded from progress.
cache.serverQuestionsChanged: Some questions changed on the server. Refresh downloaded quizzes to update them.
native.finishPicker: Finish the file picker before changing workspaces.
native.unconfirmedBody: This page may need an update, or a save may still be running. Stored quizzes and submitted offline answers stay at this address. Current unsaved text may be lost if you continue.
native.pendingBody: Pending changes: {{count}}. Answers and question edits stay stored at this server address. Return to the same address to sync them; switching does not transfer them to another workspace. You can export recovery and edit backups in Settings first.
native.setup: Study on this phone. No server or account needed. Import a quiz file from a friend, learn offline, and export a copy whenever you want.
native.optionalServer: Or connect to your own server for shared progress. Connect your VPN first if your server is private.
native.invalidAddress: Enter an HTTPS server address without a path, username or password.
native.deviceDescription: Quizzes and progress are stored on this phone. Use Export to keep a backup or share a quiz.
native.serverDescription: Sync pending progress before switching. Device-only and server workspaces stay separate.
native.prepareError: Could not prepare JSON file. Check that it is valid JSON and under 5 MB.
native.openError: Could not open quiz. Choose a readable JSON file under 5 MB.
app.savedOnDevice: Saved on this device. Export a file to back up or share your quiz.
edits.anotherTab: Another Recall tab saved newer data. Reload this tab before trying again; the other tab’s saved work was kept.
edits.storageFailed: Could not save to this device. Keep this page open and check available storage.
edits.conflictNotice: Some edits conflict with changes on the server. Review both versions in Settings before syncing again. Your edits and pending answers are kept.
edits.conflictChanged: The pending edit changed. Open the current conflict review again.
edits.resolveBeforeResetDiscard: Sync or resolve pending question edits before discarding outdated study evidence.
edits.syncBeforeReset: Sync or resolve this deck’s pending question edits before resetting its learning.
edits.title: Offline question edits
edits.help: Edit, add, import or organize questions while disconnected. Changes save here and upload on Sync. If another device changed the same question, you choose which version to keep.
edits.publishRule: New questions and corrected learning content stay in the library but enter server-backed study only after syncing. This keeps unpublished answers from earning mastery under an incorrect revision. Other downloaded questions remain available offline.
edits.none: No question edits waiting to sync.
edits.export: Export pending edits and review history
edits.exportHelp: Keep this as a personal backup. It contains older question versions and review notes. Use the ordinary quiz export to share your current bank. Exporting does not clear the queue.
edits.exported: Pending edit backup prepared. The queue is unchanged.
edits.conflictsHelp: Nothing in this batch has been overwritten. Compare the downloaded original, your edit and the current server version. Choose for every conflict, save your choices, then Sync again. A newer server change will require another review.
edits.newName: New name for this local deck
edits.nameTaken: A different server deck already uses this name. Rename your draft or discard it. No decks are merged automatically.
edits.choicesSaved: Choices saved locally. Sync again to publish; the previous versions remain in your review-history export.
edits.publishFirst: Sync your new or corrected questions before starting this server-backed study session.
edits.syncPending: Changes are saved on this device. Sync pending: {{message}}
edits.graphConflict: These choices leave missing or circular prerequisites. Keep the server versions for the affected changes, then edit the questions again. No server changes have been made.
edits.syncUnavailable: Cannot sync right now. Your saved edits and answers are still on this device. Reconnect to your server and try again.
app.mental_recall_help: Compare the answer you thought of with the model, then grade yourself honestly. No credit is given until you choose a rating.
dictation.remotePrivacy: Your browser may send microphone audio to its speech provider. Internet may be required. Press Dictate answer to start.
dictation.localPrivacy: On-device only. No automatic fallback to an online speech service.
dictation.listening: Listening… Take your time. Stop or press Enter when you are ready.
dictation.unsupported: Speech recognition is unavailable here. You can use your keyboard or operating system’s dictation.
dictation.localUnavailable: On-device speech is unavailable for this language or its language pack is missing. Use keyboard dictation, or explicitly allow the browser’s speech service in Voice options.
dictation.languageUnavailable: This speech service does not support the selected language. Try another language or keyboard dictation.
dictation.denied: Microphone or speech access was denied. You can change your browser permissions or keep typing.
dictation.failed: Dictation could not start or was interrupted. Check microphone, language and connection settings, or keep typing.
